### Connect

[**Connect with Plaud**](/api/apps/plaud/oauth/start)

Opens in a new tab. You authorize in your own browser — wherever you're already logged into [web.plaud.ai](https://web.plaud.ai) — and this app comes back connected with no token to copy and refresh handled automatically from then on.

If the message above says OAuth isn't configured yet, that's real: this app is the OAuth client, but it needs `plaud_client_id`/`plaud_client_secret` and the authorize/token endpoint URLs from Plaud's OAuth API first (still private-beta as of 2026-08-23 — see this app's `aw-plaud` skill).

Use this only while OAuth isn't connected — e.g. Plaud's OAuth credentials aren't configured yet.

1. Open **[web.plaud.ai](https://web.plaud.ai)** in a new tab and make sure you're logged in.
2. Open DevTools → Network, click any request to `api.plaud.ai`, and copy its `authorization` request header.
3. Paste it below — with or without the `Bearer ` prefix, or the whole `authorization: eyJ...` line copied straight from DevTools, all work.

The token is a short-lived JWT (~24h) with no refresh flow, so you'll repeat this roughly once a day until OAuth is connected.

fields.label: Plaud bearer token
fields.description: Stored in the zero-knowledge secret store, never in plain config. Saving re-checks the token against Plaud right away — the status line above updates with the real result.
